column3: MT 6:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “To the choirmaster” is rendered “To the Chief Musician,” and עַל־ הַשְּׁמִינִית (“on the Sheminith”) “On an eight-stringed harp.”
Close to the Hebrew; חַסְדֶּךָ (“your steadfast love”) is rendered “Your mercies’.”
Close to the Hebrew; בִּשְׁאוֹל (“in Sheol”) is rendered “In the grave.”
Close to the Hebrew; עָתְקָה (“grows weak”) is rendered “It grows old.”
